Token-identical (macro body 0x8000) so strict G1 proves value-identity; scope confined to the gameplay files where `- 0x8000` is uniformly this decode.

Encode side: a building index is written into the occupancy layer as buildingIndex + 0x8000 (e.g. 060_buildings.inc.c:216 *(_WORD*)(TILE_INDEX(row,column)) = buildingIndex + 0x8000; 050_units.inc.c:5307 written to TILE_MAP_OFFSET). All + 0x8000 sites in these files use a building-index variable. Token-identical.
